result.summary: Aranya Pharma Packaging has one open overdue invoice of INR 5.0m, now 45 days past due (due 2026-10-09, reported 2026-11-23) against a single TCI policy with a 45-day term and INR 50m limit. This is a marked deterioration versus prior history, where two earlier overdues (INR 3.0m and 2.6m) were resolved quickly in 7 and 3 days respectively. Although notification volume remains low (single policy, 2 events in last 6 months), the current overdue is already far longer-dated and unresolved than any past case, warranting close monitoring.
concerns: Current overdue (45 DPD) is significantly longer than any previously resolved case (max 7 days late)
Exposure of INR 5.0m is the largest single overdue notified to date, nearing 10% of the INR 50m credit limit
No ageing breakdown provided for the open notification, limiting visibility into severity
Single-policy reporting means any emerging pattern of delay is not yet confirmed across multiple insurers, but recent payment behavior shift warrants a review of the credit limit
